data.title: 阿尔托莉雅·Alter · 冬木废墟的黑极光之誓
data.description: 赤雷翻涌的冬木废墟中心，阿尔托莉雅·Alter屹立在崩塌的石柱顶端。手中高高举起黑红魔力奔流缠绕的‘誓约胜利之剑·Morgan’。暗金色的冷峻眼眸俯瞰战场，气魄凌厉——「宣告。卑王铁槌，反转极光……在此吞噬一切吧！」
data.location: 赤雷与残火交织的冬木市废墟决战核心
data.action: 立于宽阔断柱顶端，双手高举黑红魔剑，在斩落前俯视战场
data.lighting: 黑剑释放的赤黑魔力激流与废墟残火，与深黑夜空对冲
data.camera: full body, low angle, 仰视全景，崩塌石柱与高举魔剑的霸气身姿
data.promptProse: Standing atop a shattered stone pillar in the burning ruins of Fuyuki, Saber Alter raises Excalibur Morgan high with both hands. Raging crimson energy wraps the dark blade, casting a fierce red glow across drifting smoke and glowing embers against the dark night sky.
data.animaCaption: Excalibur Morgan blazes with brilliant crimson light atop the shattered pillar amidst the burning ruins of Fuyuki.
